scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Health factor (HF) = (collateral value × LT) ÷ debt. Below 1.0 = liquidatable.
scenes.vo: L.T.V. (loan-to-value) = debt divided by collateral value. Max L.T.V.: the most you can borrow against an asset. Liquidation threshold (LT): the L.T.V. at which your position can be liquidated. It's higher than max L.T.V.. Health factor (health factor) = (collateral value times LT) divided by debt. Below 1.0 = liquidatable. Liquidation price = debt divided by (collateral quantity times LT).
scenes.cap: LTV (loan-to-value) = debt ÷ collateral value. Max LTV: the most you can borrow against an asset. Liquidation threshold (LT): the LTV at which your position can be liquidated. It's higher than max LTV. Health factor (HF) = (collateral value × LT) ÷ debt. Below 1.0 = liquidatable. Liquidation price = debt ÷ (collateral quantity × LT).

scenes.title: Worked example
items: Max debt for HF 2.0 = $12,000; for HF 1.5 = $16,000.
